Final results and winning essays

The winners and final results of competition are declared. The award ceremony was organized on May 09, 2021. The winner essays can be read on the following links.

We congratulate all winners. All winning essays will be published online after editing.

Date of submission of essays

The new time line for submission of essays was 15 November 2020 .

Educational talk series on Health

The competition process has been  re-initiated to invite revised essays and new entries too. In this regard, an educational talk series by experts was organized from August 04,2020 to August 08, 2020. The details of talks and videos are available on page of Educational talk series on Health . All scholars are encouraged to learn and compete in this competition.The details of assessment of earlier stage of competition can be seen on the discussion link of this page.

Process of next competition

All participants of earlier competition are eligible to participate again.The registration fees is waived off for all the participants who have submitted their essays in this competition.

Those participants who are willing to improve their essays, writing skills can download the shortcomings here . They can communicate the Charak Samhita Research Training and Skill Development Centre through email for further guidance and re-submission process.

Educational videos on expected points by judges are available on Educational talk series on Health for all the participants for ready reference.

Contact

Email: carakasamhita@gmail.com

Dr.Yogesh Deole, Project Co-ordinator, Charak Samhita New Edition Project

Information about the competition

The Charak Samhita Research, Training and Skill Development Centre (CSRTSDC) is established by FHED Trust, India in collaboration with Institute for Post Graduate Teaching and Research in Ayurveda afﬁliated to Gujarat Ayurved University, Jamnagar. The live edition of Charak Samhita is published online on www.charaksamhita.com .  Ayurveda, the knowledge of life, gives due importance to prevention and preservation of health. Emphasizing upon the concept of health and its application in current practice of Ayurveda and contemporary medicine, CSRTSDC is organizing an international essay competition. Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India, has provided logo support to this event.

Future Scope and Strategies for Preservation of Health through Ayurveda

Elaboration of concept of health in Ayurveda classics and other contemporary healthcare systems

Components of health and their importance

Practical guidelines for implementing concept of health in today's society

Applied researches on preservation and protection of health

Prevention of disease occurrence and recurrence

Model healthcare system and its propagation

Future strategies for preservation of health

Atreya Award: Rs. 51000/- and certificate

Agnivesh Award: Rs. 21000/- and certificate

Charak Award: Rs. 11000/- and certificate

Dridhabala  Awards: Three Consolation Prizes of Rs. 5000/- each and certificates

Participation certificate to all new participants.

Last date of submission of essay: 15 November 2020

Registration fees for new participants: INR Rs.500/-

General guidelines

The competition is open to all under graduate, post graduate, Ph.D. scholars, registered healthcare providers, researchers and practitioners from streams of Ayurveda and Allopathy. There is no upper age limit for quality write ups in the competition.

Essay should be Original, single authored, in MS Word ﬁle format typed in Times new roman font, size 12 with 1.5 line spacing.

The language shall be English only. Language shall be understood by the global community. Use of Sanskrit words shall be minimum. The word limit is maximum 5000 words excluding references.

The authors shall include all expected topics with separate subheadings. They are free to present their ideas on the topic in the essay with proper in text references. The lacunae observed by judges in earlier essays and assessment sheet of distribution of marks can be referred for improvement in the content.

The references from Ayurveda texts should be quoted at the end of the text as references only, and not within the text. The references from standard journals and publications shall be quoted as per AMA style of referencing. The guidelines for references are also available on www.charaksamhita.com.

We adopt a policy of zero tolerance to plagiarism. All essays will undergo strict plagiarism check before sending it for review. The author should not submit any copyrighted material without proper permission. In such case, a separate permission letter shall be attached with the registration form. The author will solely be responsible for any issue arising out of copyright or conﬂict of interest of submitted essay.

In order to follow a blind review system, identity should not be revealed in any form in the essay.

The essays will be reviewed and assessed anonymously by the review panel of the Board. The decision of judges will be ﬁnal. No queries will be entertained after declaration of results. Successful candidates will be invited for the award ceremony.

The Board of CSRTSDC reserves all rights to modify rules as and when needed.

The old participants need not to pay any registration fees. However they shall submit the earlier registration form only with revised essay file.

Step I: The participant are required to enroll themselves through the online form on the link https://forms.gle/Cq5pyxwi5pZ9czTGA

Step II: Download the pdf of registration form from the link Download Registration form , fill it and scan it.

Step III: Pay the registration fees online in the account below:

The registration fees of Rs.500/- shall be transferred through Wire Transfer / Internet Banking (NEFT/IMPS) / google pay etc. only to the account mentioned below:

Account Name: FHED (India) Trust Account Number: 50100324257724 Bank Name: HDFC Bank

Branch Address: E-6, Local Shopping Centre, Masjid Moth, Greater Kailash-2, New Delhi,110 048

Type of account: Savings account IFSC : HDFC0000027

The registration fees is non-refundable.

Electronic copy of receipt of transfer shall be saved for future reference.

Following three documents shall be submitted through email carakasamhita@gmail.com as attachment on or before 15 November 2020.

Essay file in MS word format

Scan copy of duly filled and signed registration form

Electronic copy of payment receipt (only for new participants)

Publication

The awarded essays will be included in the online edition of www.charaksamhita.com and www.symbiohealth.com as per suggestions of the editorial panel.

Referencing guidelines

The guidelines for references are available here .
